title: radio divider or
rule: Use a radio divider (usually “or”) for an unlike option.
pass_when: An unlike option (e.g. “None of these”, “I don’t know”) is separated with a divider, usually “or”.
fail_when: Unlike option sits in the same undifferentiated list as the similar options.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: That every set needs a divider.
